ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible surface with localized high-intensity (white) disruptions occupying less than 10% of total fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity base; sparse stochastic white mottling across both lobes; high-density, high-contrast white pixel clusters concentrated at the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees; vertex positioned at the lowest point of the trailing edge contour.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular topography; prominent macro-notch located on the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the center; high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the distal regions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex curvature along the superior margins of both lobes, terminating in pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white) located at the lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast linear pixel streaks (rake marks) observed; prominent vertical and diagonal white lines located on the medial and lateral portions of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable indentation/loss of tissue on the trailing edge of the left lobe; significant calcified clusters (barnacles) present at the distal points of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Sparse circular ring-shaped pixel patterns (possible parasitic attachment scars) distributed on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
